rationale: EMERGENCY HOTFIX, applied 2026-08-21 ~13:55Z, submitted after the fact per the review-is-after-the-fact design. Seed 496 (the config half of TL-047/bugs_open/331, edit 8 of the APPROVED round 7a82c943) mapped the per-item flag as replace_existing! — and the ! marker's semantics are 'resolve ONLY from this path' AND 'FAIL EXTRACTION when unresolved' (action_inputs.go strict-enforcement branch). From 12:12:12Z every add_tool item whose spec lacked the key — the shape every pre-496 producer emits, tool-suggester foremost — died at save_tool with 'strict !! fields did not resolve', while the work item read complete with error NULL. Measured by the webdesign_tool_rebuilds lane 90 minutes in (absence → failed run cd3812b5; explicit false → built 298fa5f8). Migration 532 swaps the marker to ? (optional-explicit, MarkedConfigKey, live in v1.0.1321 via ecc419bd1): resolution stays EXPLICIT-ONLY — the RFC_029 whole-tree search can never arm the flag, the property 496 wanted — and non-resolution passes through to plain absence, the property 496 broke. Pre-assert: exactly one active tool-generator carrying the broken key (fails closed on the two-active-rows landmine); snapshot_agent before the write; post-assert both halves (? present with the right path, ! gone). Verified live after apply. Casualty census: exactly ONE failed run fleet-wide in the 103-minute window (the reporting lane's own, self-refiled); no other site filed an add_tool. The five-round-approved change is otherwise untouched; TL-047's register entry and WRONG_CALLS now carry the layer lesson: an action-level pin ('absent ⇒ byte-identical') cannot see a config-grammar refusal.
